abstract: On 29 May 2024, a captivating Bootcamp on artificial intelligence in media was held, organized by SMPTE Montreal. The event chaired by Francois Bourdua, SMPTE Governor 2024 (Canada) brought together 245 participants in the room and some others via streaming in a dynamic and engaging atmosphere. Eighteen expert presenters shared their knowledge and vision, sparking interest and engagement from the audience. The presentations were interactive, allowing participants to ask questions in real-time, enriching the debates and discussions. The feedback from participants was extremely positive, highlighting the quality and relevance of the presentations. The day concluded with a networking “Happy Hour” session, offering an excellent opportunity to strengthen professional ties and forge new collaborations.
